description: This file contains Go source code for a package named 'merge2' that provides functions and types for merging YAML nodes (RNode) with support for different merge strategies, comments, and styles. It includes functions for merging nodes directly or from strings, and a Merger struct implementing the walk.Visitor interface with methods for handling maps, scalars, and lists during merge operations.

classes.name: Merger
classes.description: A struct implementing the walk.Visitor interface for merging YAML nodes with custom logic for maps, scalars, and lists, including comment and style handling.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges fields from src into dest YAML nodes using walk.Walker with Merger as visitor.

methods.name: MergeStrings
methods.description: Parses source and destination YAML strings, merges them, and returns the resulting YAML string.

methods.name: VisitMap
methods.description: Handles merging logic for YAML map nodes, including delete, replace, and null handling.

methods.name: VisitScalar
methods.description: Handles merging logic for scalar nodes, overriding or keeping values.

methods.name: VisitList
methods.description: Handles merging logic for list nodes, including add, clear, and replace strategies.

methods.name: SetStyle
methods.description: Copies style from source to destination node, with special handling for empty maps or sequences.

methods.name: SetComments
methods.description: Copies comments from source to destination node if present.
